move-or-borrow.title: Values and ownership lab
move-or-borrow.brief: Compare moving and borrowing a String, reproduce E0382, and repair the program.

job-transition.title: Structs, enums and matching lab
job-transition.brief: Implement and test an exhaustive state transition for a job with a structured identifier.

parse-count.title: Option, Result and recoverable errors lab
parse-count.brief: Implement fallible parsing with Result and optional input with Option; test missing and malformed input.

text-summary.title: Collections and iterators lab
text-summary.brief: Build a CLI that counts nonempty lines and words; test empty input and whitespace.

borrowed-prefix.title: A borrowed prefix API
borrowed-prefix.brief: Return a borrowed prefix without allocation, then grow the owner after the view’s last use.

event-reducer.title: A typed event reducer
event-reducer.brief: Apply payload-carrying enum events to state and test every variant without cloning the payload.

parse-pair.title: A typed key/value parser
parse-pair.brief: Distinguish malformed shape, invalid numbers and zero in a fallible two-number parser.

indexed-values.title: Keep input positions while parsing
indexed-values.brief: Retain original line numbers for valid values, filter invalid input and test empty collections.

cargo-counter.title: Create and check a Cargo binary
cargo-counter.brief: Create a dependency-free Cargo project, implement a bounded counter step and run check, build, tests and the executable.

bounded-total.title: Sum selected values through control flow
bounded-total.brief: Compute a widened total of odd integers with inclusive ranges; test empty and boundary cases.

private-meter.title: Protect a bounded meter behind methods
private-meter.brief: Keep fields private, expose a bounded update API and reproduce a private-field compiler error.

facade-paths.title: Build a stable module facade
facade-paths.brief: Re-export a type from a private implementation module and combine root-relative and parent-relative paths.

word-tally.title: Count words with an owned-key map
word-tally.brief: Normalize case, count repeated Unicode words and query owned String keys using borrowed slices.

clean-readings.title: Clean a vector in place
clean-readings.brief: Sort and deduplicate nonnegative readings while keeping ownership of the original vector.

generic-clamp.title: Constrain a generic interval operation
generic-clamp.brief: Compare borrowed values through Ord, copy a bounded result and reject reversed intervals.

named-report.title: Report through a trait contract
named-report.brief: Implement shared naming behavior, inherit or override a default method and render a generic slice.
